manual_version: Sony GS Users Manual v6.0 April2002
review_method: Root visually inspected rendered printed/PDF pages62 and127 after pypdf locator search. No PDF or page image copied into public evidence.
bounded_paraphrase: LCM bit0 chooses fixedLOD=K when1. K occupies TEX1 bits43:32 with a signed format containing four fractional bits.
MXL occupies bits4:2; MMIN bits8:6 value2 chooses point samples with nearest mip level. MTBA bit9 zero uses explicit MIPTBP registers.
At fixed integerLOD1 or2 with MXL2 and MMIN2, the specified level is1 or2; level0 at LOD0.
The manual separately cautions against bilinear/trilinear use at widths/heights4orless. Authored fixture uses point sampling MMIN2 and MMAG0.
